display_name: Routing Signal Scorer Semantic and ML Adoption Safety Boundary
description: Requires a demonstrated current gap and existing-capability review before semantic, embedding, vector, provider, or ML expansion.
user_intent_examples: Before implementing embeddings, canonize the semantic readiness plan.
Design routing_signal_scorer v3 with semantic evidence but no ML implementation yet.
Can we use sentence-transformers or FAISS in KANDA Reasoner?
Plan the Metadata Vector Manifest and retrieval evaluation before embeddings.
when_to_load: When KANDA work involves ML, embeddings, semantic retrieval/search, vector indexes/databases, semantic scorer work, routing_signal_scorer v3, Metadata Vector Manifest, corpus generation, retrieval evaluation, or adoption of libraries such as sentence-transformers, FAISS, Qdrant, or Chroma.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for ordinary lexical routing-scorer patches, simple Fast Path explanations, non-routing ML discussion unrelated to KANDA, or as a substitute for the actual routing_signal_scorer source and freeze context during implementation.
title: Routing Signal Scorer Semantic and ML Adoption Safety Boundary
